id: title:jurajmajerik:precompute metric events for id valued mean math

review.posthog_relevance: Adds support for precomputing DAU and unique session mean metrics in HogQL, including the necessary type distinctions and read-path selection, while retaining fallback behavior for unsupported cases.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F1.H1 documents the implementation of precomputed mean metrics for DAU and unique sessions, while P1.F2.H1 and P1.F2.H2 implement the necessary type distinctions and conditional selection of value expressions. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement. The chunk P1.F8 and P1.F6 are excluded as they contain only test snapshots and HogQL query changes

observations.limitations: This chunk is a documentation and implementation change. P1.F1.H1 is documentation only. P1.F2.H1, P1.F2.H2, P1.F2.H3, P1.F2.H4, P1.F3.H1, P1.F4.H1, P1.F4.H2, P1.F5.H1, P1.F5.H3 are implementation and test. P1.F5.H2 is a snapshot name change. No tier assignment is made.

observations.behavior: Documentation update: the markdown documentation is updated to include the new supported metric types (dau, unique_session) and the exclusion of unique-group and HogQL math.
observations.code_quote: Implemented for **ordered funnels**, **count/sum/avg/min/max mean metrics** (per-event value stored in `numeric_value`, deduplicated on read by event identity since replayed build rows would double sums and skew averages; the aggregation itself runs at read time, so all five math types store identical rows), **dau/unique_session mean metrics** (the read counts distinct IDs from `entity_id`/`session_id`, which every mean build stores; `numeric_value` holds the same constant a count metric stores, so a count metric and an ID-math metric on the same source share build jobs), and **retention metrics**. Unordered funnels, unique-group and HogQL math, and ratio metrics are not precomputed; breakdowns, CUPED, and data warehouse sources always fall back to a direct scan.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies the supported scope of the metric-events precomputation feature, including the new ID-valued math support and the fallback behavior for unsupported cases.
Allows the query builder to distinguish between numeric and ID-valued math types.

observations.behavior: Adds conditional selection of the value expression based on the math type. For DAU, it selects the entity_id. For unique_session, it selects session_id. For other types, it selects numeric_value.
observations.posthog_connection: Implements the read path for ID-valued math, selecting the appropriate column to count distinct IDs rather than numeric values.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains only test snapshot and test implementation changes. No production implementation, configuration, or shared library changes are supplied. The score cannot be assigned.
